purpose: Field-level primary-source evidence batch for Finland, Italy and Norway.

records.claim: Applicants for a Finnish study residence permit must have at least EUR 800 per month available for living costs; for studies lasting at least one year, the normal first-year amount is EUR 9,600, with tuition funds required separately where applicable.
records.methodology: Direct review of current Finnish Immigration Service student income guidance.

records.claim: Finland's study residence permit route applies to qualifying studies and requires the applicant to demonstrate the conditions for the permit, including admission/enrolment and sufficient financial resources under the applicable rules.
records.methodology: Direct review of current Finnish Immigration Service study-permit guidance.

records.claim: For a Finnish residence permit for an employed person, gross salary must be at least EUR 1,600 per month in 2026, excluding certain supplements; other work-permit categories have their own income thresholds.
records.methodology: Direct review of current Finnish Immigration Service income-requirement guidance.

records.claim: Italy requires study applicants to demonstrate adequate financial means; an official 2026/2027 study-visa checklist states a minimum of EUR 783.06 per month for subsistence, alongside evidence of regular/stable financial resources and accommodation.
records.sourceAuthority: Italian Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation
records.methodology: Direct review of an official Italian diplomatic mission study-visa checklist for academic year 2026/2027, cross-checked against the Ministry's general financial-means guidance.

records.claim: Italy's study visa route applies to applicants admitted to qualifying study programmes; applicants must satisfy the applicable visa documentation and entry requirements for study in Italy.
records.sourceAuthority: Italian Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation
records.methodology: Direct review of current Italian Ministry study-visa guidance and official financial-resource guidance.

records.claim: Applicants for a Norwegian study permit must demonstrate sufficient funds to support themselves during the study period, with the applicable amount and evidence requirements set by UDI for the relevant study permit application.
records.methodology: Direct review of current UDI study-permit requirements; no unsupported numeric amount is inserted where the source page's applicable figure depends on the current application context.

records.claim: Norway's skilled-worker residence route requires the applicant to qualify as a skilled worker and satisfy the applicable employment, qualification and job-offer conditions set by UDI.
records.methodology: Direct review of current UDI skilled-worker residence guidance.
